newsitem.title: ARMENIA: Seven Azeri soldiers killed near Armenian border.
newsitem.headline: Seven Azeri soldiers killed near Armenian border.

text.p: Seven Azeri soldiers were killed and one was wounded when Armenian forces opened fire near their border with Azerbaijan, the local Respublika Armenia newspaper reported on Saturday.
The report quoting an Armenian defence ministry spokesperson said the shooting occurred on Thursday afternoon after an armed group of Azeri soldiers crossed the southeastern Armenian-Azeri border.
Several Azeris escaped but seven were killed and one was wounded. There were no casualties among the Armenians, the report said.
Armenia is engaged in a bitter dispute with Azerbaijan over the enclave of Nagorno-Karabakh, an ethnic Armenian enclave in Azerbaijan.
Tens of thousands of people were killed on both sides after the age-old conflict flared up again in the late 1980s before the two sides struck a truce in 1994.
The Armenians gained the upper hand in the fighting and still control a large swathe of Azerbaijan.
